en: A colorized landscape view of a manicured garden or park. A curving path winds through a bright green lawn bordered by dense flower beds filled with red, pink, yellow, and white blossoms, possibly azaleas or rhododendrons. Behind the flowers stands a backdrop of tall mixed deciduous and coniferous trees under a clear blue sky. There is no visible text or border design on the image side.
